result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is a notable mismatch between the active 'Pizza' filter and the displayed content, plus a few minor carousel/truncation concerns.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip is selected (highlighted dark), yet the visible results include non-pizza venues: Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, and Tokumaru Ramen Bar (tagged 'Ramen'). The filter appears to have no effect on the listings.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the selected category filter actually filters the 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections, or visually reset the chip to 'All' if the sections are not filterable.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...') with no ellipsis or visual affordance indicating horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add a peeking-card gradient/fade or truncate the name with an ellipsis so users understand the row scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right screen edge with almost no visible content, making it look like a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so a meaningful portion of the next chip peeks into view, or add a fade edge to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image sits on a variable dark photo background without a consistent backing, risking low contrast on lighter images (the pizza card below uses a dark circle backing, creating inconsistency).
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-opaque circular backing behind all favorite icons for consistent contrast and styling across cards.
